metadata.title: Probabilistic Computing Lab — Stochastic Computing Paper Map

papers.title: Computation on Stochastic Bit Streams Digital Image Processing Case Studies
papers.authors: Peng Li; David J. Lilja; Weikang Qian; Kia Bazargan; Marc D. Riedel
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) Systems
papers.innovation: Maps FSM-based stochastic computational elements (SCEs) onto five classical digital image processing kernels and compares them to binary-radix designs.

papers.title: A 7.92 Gb/s 437.2 mW Stochastic LDPC Decoder Chip for IEEE 802.15.3c Applications
papers.authors: Xin-Ru Lee; Chih-Lung Chen; Hsie-Chia Chang; Chen-Yi Lee
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers
papers.innovation: First silicon-proven multi-rate stochastic LDPC decoder for IEEE 802.15.3c (rates 1/2, 5/8, 3/4, 7/8; n=672).

papers.title: STRAUSS: Spectral Transform Use in Stochastic Circuit Synthesis
papers.authors: Armin Alaghi; John P. Hayes
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems
papers.innovation: Establishes a fundamental link between stochastic circuits and Boolean spectral transforms (UP/BP/IBP formats).

papers.title: Stochastic Iterative MIMO Detection System: Algorithm and Hardware Design
papers.authors: Jienan Chen; Jianhao Hu; Gerald E. Sobelman
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers
papers.innovation: Proposes Stochastic Iterative MIMO (SIM): MCMC/Gibbs MIMO detection where the channel decoder directly updates Gibbs samples.

papers.title: A Fast Fault-Tolerant Architecture for Sauvola Local Image Thresholding Algorithm Using Stochastic Computing
papers.authors: M. Hassan Najafi; Mostafa E. Salehi
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) Systems
papers.innovation: Maps Sauvola local document binarization to unipolar SC with fixed 9×9 windows.

papers.title: Area-Efficient Scaling-Free DFT/FFT Design Using Stochastic Computing
papers.authors: Bo Yuan; Yanzhi Wang; Zhongfeng Wang
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems II: Express Briefs
papers.innovation: First high-accuracy scaling-free stochastic FFT (plus improved stochastic DFT) via two-line SC and a carry-aware adder (λ-bounded counter).

papers.title: Bayesian Inference With Muller C-Elements
papers.authors: Joseph S. Friedman; Laurie E. Calvet; Pierre Bessière; Jacques Droulez; Damien Querlioz
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers
papers.innovation: Shows a Muller C-element on uncorrelated stochastic bitstreams computes Bayes' rule (Eq. 7 ≡ Eq. 9).

papers.title: Hardware and Energy-Efficient Stochastic LU Decomposition Scheme for MIMO Receivers
papers.authors: Jienan Chen; Jianhao Hu; Jiangyun Zhou
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) Systems
papers.innovation: Stochastic LU decomposition for small/medium MIMO matrices using dual partition computation (DPC) to cut stream length for high bit-width signals.

papers.title: Stochastic Circuit Design and Performance Evaluation of Vector Quantization for Different Error Measures
papers.authors: Ran Wang; Jie Han; Bruce F. Cockburn; Duncan G. Elliott
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) Systems
papers.innovation: Designs stochastic VQ encoders for L1-norm, squared L2-norm, and third-law (p=3) error metrics with FSM tanh comparators, Bernstein polynomials, and index embedding in the bit stream.
